description: Fix pagination for EPSS sort: fall back to offset-based pagination when the server does not emit next_cursor (which is intentional for EPSS sort). Also fix the aria-label i18n issue on the direction toggle button.
steps: In vulnerabilities.component.ts loadData(), when sort starts with 'epss', send params.offset instead of cursor
In loadData() response handler, when nextCursor is empty, fall back to computing hasNextPage from total > currentPage * limit
In onPageChange(), when EPSS sort is active, use offset-based navigation instead of cursor stack manipulation
Fix the aria-label on the direction toggle button to remove the dynamic binding that bypasses i18n extraction
acceptance_criteria: When EPSS sort is active and there are more results than the limit, hasNextPage is true
When EPSS sort is active, offset is sent to the API instead of cursor
The aria-label i18n issue is resolved
